text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Saudi Arabia RC. As the two 
of us were heading to the racetrack, a 
news broadcast played on an electronics 
store monitor—

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"Symboli Rudolf has achieved the 
monumental feat of claiming two legs of 
the Classic Triple Crown undefeated!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"Is winning the Kikuka Sho still your 
definitive future goal?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The Kikuka Sho is said to be won by 
the strongest Umamusume. It will be 
difficult, but considering the heights I 
strive for, I must see it through—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A light tap on the head snaps me back to 
my senses.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a familiar face, so I couldn't help 
but stop in my tracks.
choice_data_list: Even so, to make it this far undefeated...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she can win the Kikuka Sho, she will 
become the first undefeated Triple Crown 
Umamusume in history.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
“—It's the perfect story for a fairytale 
dream like wanting to make every Umamusume 
happy.”

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Before long, everyone will look up to her. 
Blindly believing that figure alone is 
true, and the king they ought to follow.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
She wholeheartedly believes that to be 
salvation, without a single doubt.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli walks away briskly. ...Just 
because she didn't like how things were 
done, would someone as composed as her 
really snap like this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I have a feeling there's something more 
to it than that, though—"
choice_data_list: (I wonder if she'll ever tell me...)
(I wonder if she'll tell me someday...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Given her personality, it seems like a 
difficult question to ask... but if 
there's a chance, I'd like to try.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The autumn wind dances at my feet. The 
distant buzz of the graded race carries on 
the breeze.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Saudi Arabia RC quietly got 
underway.
